gaps.title: pos_received_amount precision mismatch

gaps.title: Race condition audit dependency

result.facet: Database + Management: Encaissement Payment Persistence & Z-Report Aggregation
result.summary: Encaissement persists via orders (pos_payment_method numeric), transactions (payment_method label), and CashMovement (no payment_method column). Z-report stores numeric enum keys (1,2,5) instead of readable labels in total_by_method JSON. CashMovement lacks payment_method column for per-method reconciliation. Only CASH counter payments record CashMovement; CARD/TICKET_RESTAURANT skip entirely.

gaps.title: Z total_by_method stores numeric keys (1,2,5) instead of readable labels
gaps.detail: ZReportService::applyOrderToTotals line 666 casts pos_payment_method (numeric) to string, storing JSON keys '1','2','5' instead of 'counter_cash'. Z immutable post-close; historical audits see unreadable numerics.

gaps.title: CashMovement has no payment_method column for per-method breakdown
gaps.detail: Migration 2026_05_08_140100 defines type/direction only. After 20 CASH + 20 CARD in one session, cannot query to segregate expected_cash from expected_card. Reconciliation impossible.

gaps.title: CARD/TICKET counter payments skip CashMovement recording entirely
gaps.detail: confirmCounterPayment line 442 calls recordCashOrderMovement only for CASH mode. CARD/TICKET bypass CashMovement. No audit trail for non-cash tender via cash_movements table.

gaps.title: Fallback in applyOrderToTotals line 666 never triggers
gaps.detail: pos_payment_method always truthy (1,2,5), so fallback to payment_method never executes. Dead code for counter payments. Two columns, one correct never used.

gaps.title: Admin normalization runtime-only; historical Z-reports opaque
gaps.detail: CashOverviewController normalizes at query time. Z-reports store numeric keys permanently. Auditor viewing Z directly sees unreadable '1','2','5' in total_by_method JSON.

gaps.detail: NF525ComplianceE2ETest tests single-method kiosk only. No test seeds 20 CASH + 20 CARD + 20 TICKET in one Z. Impossible to verify total_by_method correctness with all methods.

result.facet: CLOUD-READINESS: Multi-Instance Pre-Cutover Gate V1 Local → Cloud
result.summary: V1 LOCAL enforces 14 boot guards (AppServiceProvider:158-453). For ALB: shared Redis MANDATORY, fiscal secrets rotate, bypass modes disabled, MySQL triggers preserved. SESSION_DRIVER=file safe locally, needs ALB sticky-session or redis for cloud.

gaps.title: Shared Cache Driver for Multi-Pod Lock Serialization
gaps.detail: AppServiceProvider:294-302 forbids array/null in production. Current: redis (PASS). ALB: Cache::lock(audit_chain) serializes across pods. In-process drivers allow UNIQUE collision. Cloud: redis/memcached.

gaps.title: Idempotency Middleware Enabled on 23 Routes
gaps.detail: AppServiceProvider:223-231 requires IDEMPOTENCY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED=true in production. Current: enabled (PASS). config/idempotency.php:34-86 covers counter-collect, cash-drawer, status-changes. Dual-layer: cache-lock + DB UNIQUE.

gaps.title: Fiscal Secrets Must Rotate to Production Grade
gaps.detail: config/fiscal.php:31,38 require FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET and FISCAL_Z_REPORT_SECRET. Current: local-e2e padding. Cloud: 32+ char random secrets. 6-year NF525 retention legally required.

gaps.title: APP_URL Must Match Cloud Domain for CORS
gaps.detail: AppServiceProvider:261-271 refuses boot if APP_URL empty. Current: localhost:8000. config/cors.php:6 derives origins from APP_URL. Cloud: set https://domain. Missing causes /api/broadcasting/auth CORS rejection.

gaps.title: BROADCAST_DRIVER Must Not Be null/sync
gaps.detail: AppServiceProvider:273-278 forbids null/sync in production. Current: pusher. Cloud: Pusher/Soketi with PUSHER_APP_ID/KEY/SECRET. Real-time depends on this.

gaps.title: Bypass Modes Must Be Disabled in Production
gaps.detail: AppServiceProvider:177-190, 165-171 refuse bypass=true in production. Current: all true (local OK). Stubs (hardware checks only, fiscal unaffected). Cloud: set false.

gaps.title: SESSION_DRIVER File Unsafe for Multi-Pod ALB
gaps.detail: config/session.php:21 defaults to file. Local safe. ALB multi-pod: sessions on Pod A invisible to Pod B. Cloud: sticky-session OR redis. Deferred when ALB introduced.

gaps.title: MySQL Triggers Enforce NF525 Immutability
gaps.detail: Migration 2026_05_10_010000:107-141 creates BEFORE DELETE triggers (MySQL/MariaDB only). RDS: preserve via mysqldump --triggers. Protects cash_movements, order_payments, cash_drawer_sessions.

Fiscal secrets: rotate before go-live. 6-year retention. Cloud: S3 via FISCAL_ARCHIVE_DISK.
MySQL triggers: BEFORE DELETE on payments enforces immutability. RDS: mysqldump --triggers.
Broadcast: Pusher/Soketi + config/broadcasting.php timeouts prevent worker hangs.

Queue: redis + dedicated worker pod. config/queue.php:75 block_for=5s enables blocking BRPOP.
Boot guards catch all 14 misconfigs fail-fast. Fix .env and restart; no runtime recovery.

MySQL triggers mandatory NF525; RDS preserve. Cloud checklist: rotate secrets, disable bypasses, set APP_URL, redis, Pusher, preserve triggers.
